newsitem.title: USA: ESC Medical stake cut by Zweig-DiMenna.
newsitem.headline: ESC Medical stake cut by Zweig-DiMenna.

text.p: A group led by Zweig-DiMenna Partners LP said Wednesday it lowered its stake in ESC Medical Systems Ltd to 801,900 ordinary shares or 4.7 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 271,000 ordinary shares sold between January 2 and February 20 at prices ranging from $26.5250 to $37.25 per share.
ESC, based in Yokneam in northern Israel, is a maker of cosmetic-surgery lasers.
